scripts.sync-env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('.env', 'backend/.env'); fs.copyFileSync('.env', 'venture-wolf/.env'); console.log('✅ Synchronized root .env to backend and frontend!');"
scripts.dev: npm run sync-env && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix venture-wolf"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix venture-wolf
